name: hindsight
one_liner: A memory system for AI agents so they remember past conversations and actually learn from them instead of starting fresh every time.
buyer: A SaaS founder building a customer-support or sales AI agent who needs it to remember each customer across sessions without building memory infrastructure themselves.
business_use_cases: A customer-support SaaS adds 'remembers every past ticket per customer' as a premium feature, powered by this instead of a custom vector-store build.
An AI sales-assistant startup uses it so the agent recalls a prospect's stated budget and objections across multiple calls instead of re-asking every time.
An agency building custom AI agents for clients standardizes on it as their memory layer, cutting weeks off every new client build.

money_ideas.idea: Charge implementation fees to integrate persistent memory into a client's existing AI agent.
Resell the hosted 'Hindsight Cloud' tier bundled with your own agent product at a markup.

steal_this: Build a tiny demo: a support-chat widget that visibly remembers a returning visitor's last three questions, and pitch it to one SaaS founder as 'this is what your bot could do by Monday.'
